title: Former Tehelka editor Tarun Tejpal surrenders before Goa court; sent to jail to serve 10-year sentence
summary: On August 25, the Supreme Court had directed Tejpal to surrender within three weeks to undergo his 10-year prison sentence following his conviction by the Bombay High Court

title: Revised design clears hurdle for Pavangad ROB approach road
summary: The Kerala State Electricity Board had served a notice to the Public Works Department directing it to stop piling work after 110-kV and 11-kV underground power cables were found passing through the site where the approach road was being constructed

title: Assam man accused of wife’s beheading dies after jumping from police vehicle
summary: Ramanuj Goswami was put under arrest after he surrendered last week and confessed to killing his wife Riya Talukdar in a fit of rage over her alleged extra-marital affair

title: Dhruv Vikram next is ‘Jackie,’ produced by Mythri Movie Makers; first look out
summary: The film is directed by Karan Arvind Kumar, who previousy worked as an assistant director under writer-director RJ Balaji

title: West Bengal government issues closure notice to 252 unaided and unrecognised madrasas
summary: The Madrasah Education system in Bengal has a history of almost 250 years and it grew and flourished with the foundation of the Calcutta Madrasah in 1780 by the British East India Company

title: CBI registers FIR in Disha Salian death case
summary: Earlier, Bombay High Court ordered a CBI probe into Disha Salian's death and pulled up Mumbai Police for failing to register an FIR for six years, observing that its investigation raises more questions than answers

title: Police officer under probe in Keralam after seized tobacco stolen from station
summary: The investigation is against Senior Civil Police Officer Sabith, who is suspected of stealing the seized products from the station and has been untraceable since the incident came to light, officials said

title: Indian-origin man wanted in U.S. for Medicare fraud
summary: Mohammed used American Premier to submit approximately $93 million in alleged fraudulent Medicare claims, resulting in payments of at least $65 million, the Office of the Inspector General, says Department of Health and Human Services
